create_lie_tensor_exp: create a LieTensor by calling SE3.exp on a tangent vector tensor
create_lie_tensor_jexp: create a LieTensor and its jacobians by calling SE3.jexp on a tangent vector
convert_hat: convert a tangent vector to its matrix representation using SE3.hat
convert_vee: convert a matrix back to its tangent vector using SE3.vee
lift_and_project: lift a matrix to Lie group representation or project it back using SE3.lift and SE3.project
